source.check: returned unopposed: 'there will be no contest in any of the divisions'; sole nomination, read on the page image (Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1)

note: Triennial election of the seventeen electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, 5 June 1958. There was no contest in any division: seventeen nominations for seventeen seats (Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1; Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 11). Returned unopposed.
